description: This file is a header file (`.h`) defining utility functions and structures within the `beerocks` namespace for the prplMesh project. It includes various static helper functions for string manipulation, interface identity handling, bandwidth conversions, timestamp formatting, and flag analysis, intended to support network interface and wireless configurations.
